lesson.title: Long shots look cheap
lesson.body: MIL at 16% pays about 6.2 times your money, which feels attractive. But it loses about 84% of the time if the price is right, and an over-confident model sees fake value here most often. Our learning agent taught itself to skip sides priced at 35 cents or less.
